properties.notes: Land adjacent to Corbridge railway station that is partly occupied by a range of uses, the remainder being vacant. Unoccupied industrial workshops, a commercial laundry and scrap yard are currently in situ. Identified as having potential for mixed-use redevelopment as part of a wider redevelopment of this industrial land at Corbridge station (9041, 9073). . An application for 12 townhouses and 6 apartments alongside commercial/industrial uses has now been permitted (14/04259/FUL). Development is yet to start but forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
properties.site-address: Jools Laundry, Tinklers Bank, East of Corbridge Station
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
